$comment: The AndroidX Wear Remote Compose Material 3 samples pin for :samples-catalog. `ref` is a COMMIT SHA and never a branch, so a render is reproducible and an upstream bump is a reviewable diff. Bumping `wear-compose-remote` in gradle/libs.versions.toml means re-resolving this ref in the same PR. `paths` includes both the `@Sampled` sources and `previews/utils` (which supplies `RemoteComponentPreviewWrapper`, `ImageUtils`, `TestImageVectors`, and `ProfilePreviewParameterProvider`). `resourcePaths` carries the drawables the samples resolve `R.drawable.*` against.
refDescription: androidx-main on 2026-11-04 (`Make RemoteAction.None public API`), matching androidx.wear.compose.remote:remote-material3 1.0.0-alpha15 (published 2026-11-04).
